# Validation

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "calibration",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "calibration-theory.html",
    Implementation = "calibration-implementation.html",
    Benchmarks = "calibration-benchmarks.html",
    Validation = "calibration-validation.html"
  )
)
```

SOEMS is checked as a solid elastic calibration sphere over frequency, orientation, diameter, and elastic material parameterizations.

::: {.tip data-title="Residuals near nulls"}
Mean absolute differences describe the typical agreement; maximum differences are retained because deep nulls can expose localized convention or resolution errors.
:::
